A '''flight instructor''', also known as '''pilot trainers''', were individuals who trained other beings how to [[Pilot/Legends|fly]].

==History==
[[T'Charek Haathi]] served as a flight instructor for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]] was a freelance flight instructor who would teach anyone who could pay how to fly.
